episode: East Bench House Phase 3, Master Suite and Laundry Room

assessment: Phase three of the East Bench House: the master suite and the laundry room. A strong showcase episode, weak for problem and solution beyond one beat: the homeowners never used the old tub because it was uncomfortable, and the old shower head sat in an odd spot. The finished master bath carries the Short. Mike calls the shower a car wash, with nozzles, hand sprays, shower heads and an LED rain head that changes colour from a remote, plus a wrap around lit niche. Then a deep jetted tub with air bubbles and a hand spray, sinks made from the countertop material, outlets and USB ports in the back of the drawers, and a fountain wall that is a mirror when the water is off. The laundry took over the old walk in closet and has a built in ironing board. Mike is in most of the reveal, so every shot is cropped to the feature with him at the edge or out.

project_context.summary: The third phase of the East Bench House: the master bedroom got new flooring, lights, trim and a new walk in storage closet, the master bath was taken to the studs and rebuilt with a bigger shower, a new tub and a new vanity, and the old walk in closet became an expanded laundry room with a linen closet.

The end card plays over the fountain wall at 35:05, before the burned in graphics start. The hallway and the new storage closet are left out because Mike fills the frame in both.

yt_description.hook: This dated master suite got taken down to the studs. Now it has a laundry room, a refreshed bedroom, and a bathroom with a shower that works like a car wash.
yt_description.project: This is phase three of the East Bench House, the master suite and the laundry room. The old walk in closet became a bigger laundry room, the bedroom got new flooring, lights and trim, and the master bath was rebuilt with a wider, longer shower, a new tub and a new vanity.
yt_description.features: The laundry room has a sink, extra deep cabinets and an ironing board that folds out of the wall. A barn door opens on the bath, where the shower has nozzles, hand sprays and an LED rain head that changes color, with a wrap around lit niche. There is a deep jetted tub, sinks made out of the countertop material, and a fountain wall that turns into a mirror when the water is off.
